boundary: Actual EpisodeNfoParser over exact UTF-8 temporary files. Controlled IUserManager and IUserDataManager proxies preserve zero-id temporary block reads, existing-item saves, cancellation and injected non-XML failures. Item, people, images, calls and shared user-data state remain observable after parser return or exception.
uncovered: non-UTF-8 decoding already frozen by the nfo-partial-reader fixture
local image filesystem behavior already frozen by the nfo-local-images fixture
real user-data database transactions and events already frozen by the nfo-userdata-persistence fixture
Episode scalar, date, external-id and XML combinations outside the declared matrix
provider file discovery and downstream metadata refresh persistence
